command:start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }'); base=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null) || { echo "cannot tell where this task branch started: no 'gnomish: task started' commit and no origin/main"; exit 1; }; oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: NFR-R2/M7 screenshots do not match the spec: the spec's 'Approved language screenshots' table is theme × state (light/dark × collapsed/expanded at 375 px), and task 10.3 asks for 'all 4 rows'. The E2E outline in settings_language_e2e.feature:118-131 varies width (375/1024) × theme and always expands the list, so there is no collapsed language screenshot at 375 px and two 1024 px ones the spec does not ask for.

NFR-A2 'Tab and Shift+Tab MUST reach the button, the search field when shown, and every row' and 'Enter or Space MUST choose' are not tested: the spec scenario 'Choosing with the keyboard' is 'presses Tab, then Arrow Down, then Enter … the focus is on the button named «Язык: Русский»', but settings_language_e2e.feature:62-72 presses Enter, ArrowDown, ArrowDown, Enter, and InterfaceLanguageGroup.test.tsx has no Tab, Shift+Tab or Space case. The focus check also accepts any /^(Language|Язык): / name instead of «Язык: Русский».

FR5 weekday not covered: the spec scenario 'Choosing Russian applies at once' requires 'the date bar shows a Russian weekday', and task 7.4 asks for 'the Russian weekday'. settings_language_unit.feature:14 dropped that clause, and its steps (settings_language_unit.steps.tsx:57-65) check only the heading, «Казахстан», <html lang> and «Алматы». No test checks that dates or weekdays switch immediately after the choice.

FR8 migration scenario incomplete: the spec says 'THEN the theme Dark, the hour format 12-hour and the language «Русский» are in force', but the step 'the language «Русский» is in force' (settings_language_unit.steps.tsx:129-135) checks only the Russian heading and button name, never that Dark and 12-hour survived the version 1 → 2 migration in the UI.

Traceability: tasks.md requires '`Implements FR-X of add-interface-language-selection (Dn)` in the JSDoc of new or changed production code', but these changed files cite only older changes: adapters/localStoragePreferencesRepository.ts (now reads, removes and clears the legacy key, FR8; JSDoc cites only 'FR7 of add-settings-page-and-device-time-location'), controller/PreferencesProvider.tsx (setInterfaceLanguage), app/AppShell.tsx (useInterfaceLanguage), controller/useDocumentLanguage.ts, controller/useCitySearch.ts, controller/useExemplarCity.ts, presenter/presentSearchResults.ts, adapters/city-search/zoneCitiesSource.ts, adapters/city-search/createCompositeCitySearch.ts. In adapters/preferencesDocument.ts:6-9 the 'Implements FR8' JSDoc is a loose block attached to no export.
